title: jams engine project snapshot, format v1

$schema.description: The project snapshot JSON Schema this file follows.

project.description: The id of the project it pins.

engine.description: The engine version that wrote it.

at.description: When it was taken, in ms since the epoch; not part of `hash`.

propertyNames.description: An asset kind: an engine kind's name, or `<game>/<kind>` for a game's.

build.description: Each kind's schema hash in the newest build that wrote the project.

key.description: The asset's registry key, which never changes.

kind.description: An asset kind: an engine kind's name, or `<game>/<kind>` for a game's.

sha256.description: A doc's SHA-256 of its canonical UTF-8 text, a blob's SHA-256 of its bytes.

bytes.description: A blob's size in bytes, when its entry records one.

import.description: A blob's import settings, when it has any: with its bytes they give its meta, and they hold its references.

meta.description: What a blob's kind inspected from its bytes and import (a texture's pixel size, an atlas's frames), when it has any.

additionalProperties.description: One live asset, pinned by its content hash.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the key-sorted JSON of every field but `at` and `$schema`: equal content gives an equal hash.

description: A project pinned by content: each live asset's id, kind, path and content hash. What releases and live levels pin.
